description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink project and handles comparing different versions of test cases, generating diffs between selected test case versions, and displaying the differences using various diff engines.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class used for rendering templates.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class managing test case data retrieval from the database.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves arguments from the request, including test case ID, comparison options, and context.

methods.name: initializeGUI
methods.description: Sets up the GUI data structure, retrieves test case versions, and prepares labels and configuration for display.

methods.name: buildDiff
methods.description: Builds a diff data structure comparing two versions of test case attributes, handling simple and complex (steps, expected results) attributes.
